Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (CHEMBL284) that have a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to get compound_key. Join docs on compound_records.doc_id to get pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Filter by target CHEMBL284 and standard_type IC50, requiring pubmed_id or doi to be non-null. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
